correctness.rationale: The upper bound holds for arbitrary countable hosts: an independent triple has no prime rank-one realization because all three pair-common-neighbor patterns cannot be supported in disjoint paths. It forces every nonadjacent marked pair below rank two, every singleton below rank three, and the root below four. A four-profile nonadjacent pair reconstructs an induced P5 and sixth vertex; the converse uses marked path vertices x1, x2, x3 and all allowed three/four masks. Rank-two, edge minimum, EGF, and rarity estimates follow by explicit arguments. The independent standard-library checker confirms all 373 unlabelled types through 13, generic rank 3/4 on 138 types through 10, and rational EGF coefficients.
